name: Flowering Across - Ying Xia Huaqi
source:
In the season when the cherry is at full blossom, an ordinary high school girl met a sakura youkai and the story unfolded.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639690/]Steam[/url]]

Note: This VN is about the same pair of girls as [url=/v23592]Waterside Chirping[/url]. Although the developer describes it as a sequel, there is no direct connection to Waterside Chirping in the story. This is a pure VN created with the RPG Maker XP engine: no character controls, the only interactions are clicking forward and choices.
